## Read-back in words

This ledger read twelve (12) persona sheets from six (6) folders. Four (4) person models were found and counted here only, never named, because person models stay off Drive. Twenty-seven (27) edges were proposed by review and are not yet in any sheet; they are listed apart. Zero (0) faults were found. Three (3) sheets have a second copy whose bytes differ (gh7, mentat, shopgarden); which copy is the master is Corwin's to say.

## What the model was shown

To build this, the tool read the first 15 lines, the version line and the "Whose inverse I carry" section of each of the sixteen (16) sheets and person models, hashed each whole file (the bytes are hashed, not returned), and read the arrow lines of two (2) proposed sources and the lines they cite. It returned only what is printed above: names, actors, version lines, hashes, sizes, paths, and the quoted edge lines. No other line of any sheet, and no line of any person model, was returned to the model.
